pronunciation.approximation: Say "stribog" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Stribog".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "stribog" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Stribog" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Stribog
domains.subtitle: Winds
domains.lead: Stribog is winds, storms. The name means "Father of winds" and belongs to the slavic tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Stribog place winds, storms at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Stribog appears in slavic tradition as winds, storms. The name's meaning, "Father of winds", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Stribog in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Stribog remains a touchstone for understanding slavic religion, art, and identity.
